unit.title: Kickoff: Ownership, Dynamic Memory, and Debuggable C
unit.learner_profile: A strong algorithms student building practical software-engineering habits in C
learning_objectives: State and maintain ownership and lifetime invariants for a heap-backed C data structure
Implement a small C component with explicit API contracts and failure behavior
Use compiler diagnostics, tests, GDB, and a memory checker to produce reproducible debugging evidence
Make a small, reviewable Git history and document engineering decisions

completion_policy.prepared_scope: Only kickoff_c_memory_engineering_v1 is prepared by this job.
unit_completion_requires: All deliverables named in student_safe/STUDY_TASK.md are present
The submitted program is built and exercised by validator-controlled checks
The debugging record and comprehension responses are independently assessed
